visual_review.identity: Deep warm brown ground with sparse muted olive-green and dry brown broadleaf groups, a few blunt twigs and gray-brown embedded stones. Broad open soil dominates; mixed green/brown identity survives.
visual_review.style_review: Much calmer and more broadly grouped than the original leaf carpet, with roughly ten to fourteen groups including edge-clipped groups. Leaf faces have two to four angular planes and some center-fold marks; soil retains faint low-contrast cloudy texture rather than absolutely flat graphic interiors. No neon, fine leaf carpet or added standing scenery.
visual_review.scale_caveat: A broad leaf group is around180-270 native pixels, about37-55 logical units at256 period; individual leaves often6-20 units. These are larger than scattered original fine litter. Compare actual forest-mask/scene scale before binding.
visual_review.native_acceptance: Opaque native candidate reviewed, no natural seamlessness or actual-scene acceptance claimed.
